featured_reviews.name: Soniii
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently, I visited Aden Banquet in Dongri, Mazagon, for a small celebration. The hall is compact and ideal for events with around 100 guests. It’s a good choice for intimate gatherings like birthday parties or small family functions.

The ambiance is simple yet pleasant, but since everything is in one hall—including the seating area, buffet, and washroom—it does feel a bit congested. Despite being small, the space is well-maintained and serves its purpose for smaller-scale events.

Overall, Aden Banquet is a decent option for those looking for a budget-friendly and cozy venue in the area. However, the limited space might not be suitable for larger or more elaborate celebrations.

featured_reviews.review_text: This air conditioned banquet is located on the fourth floor of this sports complex. It is a really nice and well lit Banquet Hall. featured_reviews.name: Neha Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had my wedding at Rhythm Banquets, and I cannot express how grateful I am for the exceptional service we received. From start to finish, the staff made everything effortless, allowing us to focus on enjoying our special day. Especially Deepak Sir and Rashmi Ma'am were instrumental in the success of our wedding. Their attention to detail and passion for their work truly stood out. They organized everything perfectly, ensuring that every aspect of the celebration met our expectations and beyond. It felt as they were part of our family, treating our wedding as if it were their own.
In addition to their outstanding coordination, they went above and beyond by providing complimentary items that added a special touch to our event. It’s this level of care that creates a unique connection, and I now feel like they are a part of my family.
Overall, our wedding at Rhythm Banquets turned out to be exactly what I wished for, thanks to the amazing team. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a venue that combines professionalism with heartfelt service.
Thank you, Rhythm Banquets, for making our wedding day the best it could be!

featured_reviews.name: Sarthak Choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently attended the Holi at the Bay party at Bayview Lawns, and it was honestly one of the best Holi celebrations I’ve ever experienced.

The venue itself is beautiful, especially with its open layout and seaside vibe, which added a whole different energy to the event. Everything was extremely well-organized—from entry management to crowd control—making the experience smooth despite the massive turnout.

The highlight, of course, was the music. DJs like DJ Chetas, AERRO, and Maddock absolutely killed it with their sets. The crowd energy was insane, and every drop just elevated the vibe even more. It felt like a perfect mix of music, colors, and pure celebration.

The overall setup—colors, water arrangements, security, and facilities—was well handled, ensuring both fun and safety. The atmosphere was lively, vibrant, and full of positive energy throughout.

If you’re looking for a high-energy, well-managed Holi event in Mumbai, Holi at the Bay at Bayview Lawns is definitely something you shouldn’t miss.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Zainab Jabri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Najam Bagh – Deeply Disappointing and Not Worth Your Time
I attended a wedding at Najam Bagh recently, and the experience was thoroughly underwhelming. The venue feels dull, mediocre, and completely lacking in any sense of elegance or celebration. It does not live up to what one would expect from a wedding venue in any meaningful way.
The food was mediocre at best and frankly forgettable. What truly shocked me, however, was the complete absence of cutlery. Guests dressed in formal wedding attire were expected to eat with their hands, which felt thoughtless, unhygienic, and embarrassing for an event of this nature.
This venue might only suit extremely basic, low-expectation setups where standards are minimal and guests are willing to tolerate inconvenience. For anyone seeking quality, comfort, or a memorable wedding experience, this place is a hard no.
I will definitely not be returning, and I would strongly advise others to look elsewhere.

One of the best things about the venue is that it offers 2 fully air-conditioned banquet halls along with a spacious garden lawn, making it perfect for all kinds of functions and events. The decoration setup was absolutely premium and gave a very elegant feel to the event.

They also have proper parking arrangements for around 20–25 vehicles, which made things very convenient for guests. Overall, a fantastic venue with great ambience, excellent service, and supportive staff. Highly recommended for weddings, receptions, and family events!

The food quality was excellent, with delicious dishes served fresh and on time. The spacious and well-organized hall made the entire function comfortable and enjoyable for all guests.

featured_reviews.name: isha shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had booked the hall at Shubham Banquets for our wedding day, expecting professionalism and basic courtesy on such an important occasion. However, our experience was extremely disappointing and unacceptable.

Shockingly, just one month before the wedding, we were informed that we would be required to vacate the hall by 2:30 PM, as the owner, Mr. Ravi, had his own relative’s wedding at the same venue in the evening. This was despite the fact that extensions are typically available at additional cost — an option that was not even offered to us.

On the wedding day, the situation worsened significantly. From around 1:00 PM, Mr. Ravi began interrupting our wedding rituals, creating unnecessary stress and disruption during what should have been a smooth and joyful ceremony. At exactly 2:30 PM, as we were preparing to wrap up, he entered the hall and started shouting at us in front of all our guests, demanding that we vacate immediately. This behavior was not only highly unprofessional but also deeply humiliating.

This kind of conduct is completely unacceptable, especially on an occasion as significant as a wedding. It showed a complete lack of respect, empathy, and basic customer service.

Our special day was tarnished by this experience. We strongly advise others to reconsider before booking Shubham Banquets.
